import type { CollectionEntry } from 'astro:content';
import { render } from 'astro:content';
import { NOTE_GROUPS } from '../../data/note-groups';

interface Props {
  note: CollectionEntry<'notes'>;
  prev: CollectionEntry<'notes'> | null;
  next: CollectionEntry<'notes'> | null;
}

const { note, prev, next } = Astro.props;
const d = note.data;
const group = NOTE_GROUPS[d.group];
const { Content } = await render(note);
---
<main data-screen-label={`Notes · ${d.num} ${d.en}`} data-current-step={d.num}>
  <div class="b-container" style="padding-top: 40px; padding-bottom: 16px; max-width: 760px;">
    <a href="/notes" class="t-caption" style="color: var(--b-ink-soft); display: inline-block; margin-bottom: 28px;">← Notes 목차</a>
    <div style="display: flex; gap: 10px; align-items: center; margin-bottom: 16px; flex-wrap: wrap;">
      <span style="padding: 4px 12px; background: var(--b-olive-soft); color: var(--b-olive-deep); border-radius: 999px; font-size: 12.5px; font-weight: 600;">{d.num} / 13</span>
      <span class="t-caption" style="white-space: nowrap; color: var(--b-olive); text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.08px;">{group.en}</span>
      <span style="color: var(--b-ink-faint);">·</span>
      <span class="t-caption" style="white-space: nowrap;">{group.ko} 그룹</span>
    </div>
    <h1 class="t-display" style="font-size: clamp(32px, 4.5vw, 44px); margin-bottom: 14px; line-height: 1.2;">
      <span style="display: block; font-size: 0.55em; font-weight: 600; color: var(--b-olive); letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-transform: uppercase; margin-bottom: 8px;">{d.en}</span>{d.h1_lead}
    </h1>
    <p class="t-body" style="font-size: 17px; color: var(--b-ink-soft); max-width: 580px;">{d.lead}</p>
  </div>

  <div class="b-container" style="max-width: 720px; margin-bottom: 20px; display: flex; gap: 14px; align-items: center; opacity: 0.85;">
    <img src="/assets/spooni/guide.svg" alt="Bsides 마스코트 스푼이 — 기록하는 포즈" width="72" height="64" loading="lazy" style="flex-shrink: 0;" />
    <span style="font-family: var(--b-font-hand); font-size: 22px; color: var(--b-olive);">학습 노트 · {d.read_time}</span>
  </div>

  <article class="b-container" style="max-width: 720px;">
    <div class="t-body" style="font-size: 17px; line-height: 1.85; color: var(--b-ink); display: grid; gap: 20px;">
      <p style="margin: 0px; font-size: 19px; color: var(--b-ink-soft); font-style: italic;">{d.italic}</p>
      <Content />
    </div>

    <div style="margin-top: 56px; padding: 28px; background: var(--b-paper-warm); border: 1px solid var(--b-line); border-radius: 20px; display: flex; gap: 20px; align-items: center; flex-wrap: wrap; justify-content: space-between;">
      <div style="max-width: 460px;">
        <div class="t-title-3" style="margin-bottom: 6px;">이걸 워크샵에선 어떻게 다루나?</div>
        <div class="t-caption" style="line-height: 1.55;">{d.workshop_text}</div>
      </div>
      <a href="/#apply" style="padding: 12px 22px; background: var(--b-olive); color: var(--b-on-olive); border-radius: 12px; font-size: 14.5px; font-weight: 600; white-space: nowrap;">객원 멤버로 합류 →</a>
    </div>

    <nav class="b-detail-nav" style="margin-top: 56px; padding: 24px 0px 8px; border-top: 1px solid var(--b-line); display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 16px;">
      {prev ? (
        <div>
          <a href={`/notes/${prev.id}`} style="display: block;">
            <div class="t-caption" style="margin-bottom: 6px;">← {prev.data.num} {prev.data.en}</div>
            <div class="t-body-strong" style="color: var(--b-ink);">{prev.data.ko}</div>
          </a>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <div>
          <a href="/notes" style="display: block;">
            <div class="t-caption" style="margin-bottom: 6px;">← Notes 목차</div>
            <div class="t-body-strong" style="color: var(--b-ink);">13단계 처음으로</div>
          </a>
        </div>
      )}
      {next ? (
        <div style="text-align: right;">
          <a href={`/notes/${next.id}`} style="display: block;">
            <div class="t-caption" style="margin-bottom: 6px;">다음 단계 →</div>
            <div class="t-body-strong" style="color: var(--b-ink);">{next.data.num} {next.data.en} · {next.data.ko}</div>
          </a>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <div style="text-align: right;">
          <a href="/notes" style="display: block;">
            <div class="t-caption" style="margin-bottom: 6px;">사이클 끝 ↺</div>
            <div class="t-body-strong" style="color: var(--b-ink);">Notes 목차로 돌아가기</div>
          </a>
        </div>
      )}
    </nav>

def unescape(s: str) -> str:
    return (
        s.replace("&", "&")
        .replace("<", "<")
        .replace(">", ">")
        .replace(""", '"')
        .replace("'", "'")
    )


def strip_tags(s: str) -> str:
    return unescape(re.sub(r"<[^>]+>", "", s)).strip()


def yaml_str(s: str) -> str:
    s = s.replace("\\", "\\\\").replace('"', '\\"')
    return f'"{s}"'


def parse_meta(html: str) -> dict:
    meta: dict = {}
    title_m = re.search(r"<title>([^<]+)</title>", html)
    title_text = unescape(title_m.group(1)) if title_m else ""
    # "01 Intent · 의도 — Bsides Notes"
    tm = re.match(r"^(\d{2})\s+(.+?)\s+·\s+(.+?)\s+—", title_text)
    if not tm:
        raise RuntimeError(f"cannot parse title: {title_text!r}")
    meta["num"] = tm.group(1)
    meta["en"] = tm.group(2).strip()
    meta["ko"] = tm.group(3).strip()

    desc_m = re.search(r'<meta name="description" content="([^"]+)"', html)
    description = unescape(desc_m.group(1)) if desc_m else ""

    # Body lead: the <p class="t-body" ...max-width: 580px;">...</p> right after h1 in head section
    lead_m = re.search(
        r'<p class="t-body"[^>]*max-width: 580px[^>]*>([^<]+)</p>',
        html,
    )
    meta["lead"] = unescape(lead_m.group(1).strip()) if lead_m else description

    # h1_lead: text after </span> in <h1 ...><span ...>{en}</span>{h1_lead}</h1>
    h1_m = re.search(r"<h1[^>]*>\s*<span[^>]*>[^<]+</span>([^<]+)</h1>", html)
    meta["h1_lead"] = unescape(h1_m.group(1).strip()) if h1_m else ""

    # read_time: span after the spooni image, "학습 노트 · 약 8분 읽기"
    rt_m = re.search(r"학습 노트 · ([^<]+?)</span>", html)
    meta["read_time"] = unescape(rt_m.group(1).strip()) if rt_m else "약 8분 읽기"

    # italic intro: first <p style="...font-style: italic;">...</p>
    it_m = re.search(
        r'<p style="[^"]*font-style: italic;[^"]*">([^<]+)</p>',
        html,
    )
    meta["italic"] = unescape(it_m.group(1).strip()) if it_m else ""

    # workshop_text: <div class="t-caption" style="line-height: 1.55;">...</div>
    ws_m = re.search(
        r'<div class="t-caption" style="line-height: 1\.55;">([^<]+)</div>',
        html,
    )
    meta["workshop_text"] = unescape(ws_m.group(1).strip()) if ws_m else ""
    return meta


def extract_article_inner(html: str) -> str:
    # Get the <div class="t-body" style="...display: grid; gap: 20px;"> block inside <article>
    art = re.search(
        r'<article class="b-container"[^>]*>(.*?)</article>',
        html,
        re.DOTALL,
    )
    if not art:
        raise RuntimeError("article block not found")
    inner = art.group(1)
    body = re.search(
        r'<div class="t-body"[^>]*display: grid; gap: 20px;[^"]*">(.*?)</div>\s*<div style="margin-top: 56px;',
        inner,
        re.DOTALL,
    )
    if not body:
        # try without trailing marker
        body = re.search(
            r'<div class="t-body"[^>]*display: grid; gap: 20px;[^"]*">(.*)$',
            inner,
            re.DOTALL,
        )
    if not body:
        raise RuntimeError("body grid not found")
    return body.group(1)


def html_to_markdown(inner: str) -> list[str]:
    """Convert the body content sequence into markdown lines.

    Recognized blocks (in order they appear):
      - <p style="...font-style: italic;">...</p>  -> SKIP (italic frontmatter)
      - <p style="margin: 0px;">...</p>            -> paragraph (inline tags converted)
      - <h3 class="t-title-2" ...>...</h3>         -> "### ..."
      - <div style="...background: var(--b-note-mint)...">...</div> -> sticky note HTML kept inline
      - <blockquote ...>...</blockquote>           -> "> ..."
    """
    out: list[str] = []
    # Tokenize: iterate over top-level blocks. We'll walk by repeatedly
    # matching the next top-level tag.
    pos = 0
    # Pattern: matches the next <p>, <h3>, or sticky note <div> at current pos.
    block_re = re.compile(
        r"<p(\s[^>]*)?>(.*?)</p>|"
        r"<h3(\s[^>]*)?>(.*?)</h3>|"
        r'<div style="margin: 12px 0px; padding: 20px 22px; background: var\(--b-note-mint\)[^"]*">(.*?)</div>\s*</div>',
        re.DOTALL,
    )
    # The sticky note has a nested </div> structure. Simpler: detect sticky-note div by full re including its known shape.
    sticky_re = re.compile(
        r'<div style="margin: 12px 0px; padding: 20px 22px; background: var\(--b-note-mint\)[^"]*">'
        r'<div style="font-family: var\(--b-font-hand\)[^"]*">([^<]+)</div>'
        r'<div style="font-family: var\(--b-font-sans\)[^"]*">([^<]+)</div>'
        r"</div>",
        re.DOTALL,
    )

    # Greedy approach: walk forward by trying to match (in priority): sticky note, p, h3.
    italic_seen = False
    while pos < len(inner):
        # skip whitespace
        m_ws = re.match(r"\s+", inner[pos:])
        if m_ws:
            pos += m_ws.end()
            continue
        # try sticky
        m = sticky_re.match(inner, pos)
        if m:
            title = unescape(m.group(1).strip())
            body = unescape(m.group(2).strip())
            out.append(sticky_note_html(title, body))
            pos = m.end()
            continue
        # try <p ...>
        m = re.match(r"<p(\s[^>]*)?>(.*?)</p>", inner[pos:], re.DOTALL)
        if m:
            attrs = m.group(1) or ""
            content = m.group(2)
            pos += m.end()
            if not italic_seen and "font-style: italic" in attrs:
                italic_seen = True
                continue
            out.append(inline_to_md(content))
            continue
        # try <h3 ...>
        m = re.match(r"<h3(\s[^>]*)?>(.*?)</h3>", inner[pos:], re.DOTALL)
        if m:
            content = m.group(2)
            pos += m.end()
            out.append(f"### {inline_to_md(content)}")
            continue
        # try <blockquote ...>
        m = re.match(r"<blockquote(\s[^>]*)?>(.*?)</blockquote>", inner[pos:], re.DOTALL)
        if m:
            content = inline_to_md(m.group(2))
            pos += m.end()
            quoted = "\n".join("> " + line for line in content.splitlines())
            out.append(quoted)
            continue
        # unknown char — advance one to avoid infinite loop
        pos += 1
    return out


def inline_to_md(s: str) -> str:
    s = re.sub(r"<strong[^>]*>(.*?)</strong>", r"**\1**", s, flags=re.DOTALL)
    s = re.sub(r"<em[^>]*>(.*?)</em>", r"*\1*", s, flags=re.DOTALL)
    s = re.sub(r"<br\s*/?>", "  \n", s)
    # Strip any remaining tags
    s = re.sub(r"<[^>]+>", "", s)
    return unescape(s).strip()


def sticky_note_html(title: str, body: str) -> str:
    return (
        '<div style="margin: 12px 0px; padding: 20px 22px; background: var(--b-note-mint); '
        "border-radius: 12px; transform: rotate(-1deg); box-shadow: var(--b-shadow-note);\">"
        '<div style="font-family: var(--b-font-hand); font-size: 22px; color: var(--b-ink); margin-bottom: 6px;">'
        f"{title}</div>"
        '<div style="font-family: var(--b-font-sans); font-size: 14.5px; line-height: 1.55; color: var(--b-ink);">'
        f"{body}</div></div>"
    )


def build_markdown(slug: str, meta: dict, body_blocks: list[str]) -> str:
    fm_lines = [
        "---",
        f'num: "{meta["num"]}"',
        f"en: {yaml_str(meta['en'])}",
        f"ko: {yaml_str(meta['ko'])}",
        f"group: {GROUP_OF[slug]}",
        f"read_time: {yaml_str(meta['read_time'])}",

def parse_meta(html: str) -> dict:

Bsides 자체도 운영자가 미미로그 출시 직후 느낀 "혼자는 가능한데, 출시 품질이 모자라더라"라는 출처 스토리에서 시작했어요. 출처 스토리가 없으면 PRD에서 우선순위 다툼이 났을 때 결정할 기준이 없어요.

### 5가지 항목 빠르게

① **출처 스토리** — 본인 경험 또는 타인 대화에서 끌어온 한 문단. ② **문제 정의** — 누가 무엇 때문에 어떤 상태인지 한 줄로. ③ **타겟** — 1차 사용자를 좁게 정의. ④ **성공 기준** — v1 sliceiclock에서 측정 가능한 숫자 2~3개. ⑤ **핵심 가설** — 검증 단위로 H1·H2·H3.
